conclusions: The first actual synthetic USB/kernel fd execution rejected ScanInitializeOff with EBUSY from Unknown Setup with pending advertising. No queued case completed; retain failure rather than relax kernel admission.

Corrected Unknown Setup subset queues legal AdvertisingConfigureOff and ScanStop; verifies two EBUSY/ENOENT rejected ScanInitializeOff submissions per case. Six real kernel release/last-file/dup cases pass on simulated USB devices; all DLI traffic across both devices and gaps is zero, Setup/Unknown and peer snapshot remain unchanged.

The subset does not prove queued ScanInitializeOff from confirmed advertising Off, active Ready survivor queries, normal scheduler concurrency, partial cleanup, held physical responses, RF, or automatic recovery. Whole managed_preselection_live_acceptance remains false.

Partial scan collector format2 now completes real advertising configure/STOP before arming its first scan step; requires full Succeeded result/selected power and ordered actual successful USB replies. Pending/cancelled scan preserves advertising Off. Source negative regressions pass; this partial change has not passed a VM or physical held-reply gate.

Physical route command was actually submitted as a length36 libusb bulk URB, then cancelled after timeout, reaped -ENOENT with transferred0, and joined. This rules out never submitting that OUT at the host layer; it does not prove USB PHY delivery or identify a device/firmware/QEMU cause.

Read-only parent/hub/target power status remained active with zero suspended-time delta over that failed run. No host PM configuration changed; observations do not prove cold SoC power or eliminate all PM causes.

Historical verified real WS73 path is retained. Previously authorized ganged uhubctl off/on re-enumeration did not establish Ready; no new reset or host experimental kernel was introduced by these tools. Natural RCA and independent bounded automatic recovery remain OPEN.
